column1: # What the wasm build replaces in vendor/alchemy (pinned 24b72a32) and why (orchestrator D3). Vendor files are
# never edited or copied: a replaced header is taken over by port/shim/prelude.h (its include guard), a replaced
# C file is left out of the build and our own file takes its place.
# kind: header = shim header; transform = the vendor file is rewritten at build time by tools/wasm/port_src.py
# (generic rules: nested functions -> clang blocks, port/asm_rules.tsv) into build/, never into our tree;
# asm = vendor assembly routine replaced by our C (D6). status: done | todo

column5: why
Dma_Set is a register-pinned stmia in inline asm; ours stores the three DMA registers and calls Port_DmaWritten
calls ARM routines at fixed IWRAM addresses; wasm calls our C functions (Port_Iwram*)
identity matrix stores are three stmia in inline asm; plain C
smull/orr in inline asm; 64-bit product in C
FIXED_ADDRESS/FIXED_OFFSET: plain constants (identity memory map, D5) instead of MODERN's linked names
__builtin_return_address (a FAKEMATCH test) defined as NULL, which takes the same return
nested functions -> blocks (2), captured params copied to __block locals
nested function -> block
nested function -> block; captured param copied
nested functions -> blocks (2); ARM clobbers dropped from two empty asm barriers
Iwram_*Offset defined so IwramIrqMain + offset is our function: calls an IWRAM routine as IwramIrqMain + Iwram_CopyWordsOffset (address arithmetic on code)
ARM C calling IWRAM routines by offset from IwramIrqMain (IWRAM_ENTRY)
asm rules: swi 2/3 -> Port_BiosHalt/Stop, sp read/switch -> no stack copy
IWRAM routines (divide core, signed remainder, sqrt, fill/copy words, bit runs, transform vector/matrix, resident LZ): EQUIV (tests/arm/diff.cjs)
IwramCopyWords EQUIV; render, clipping and the reverb codes in mixer.c (Mixer_Enter EQUIV, GS-audio)
__divsi3/__udivsi3/__modsi3/__umodsi3 veneers
ARM veneers to ArcTan2, IwramSqrt, IwramRatioMulQ14: EQUIV
Trig_Sin/Cos: EQUIV on all 65536 angles
Heap_Release, HeapSlot_Release: EQUIV
umul3232H32 EQUIV; SoundMain (unused by the game) mixes with Camelot's mixer (SoundMainRAM not ported)
CpuSet and SoundBias from GBATEK: EQUIV against the harness's GBATEK reference
SoundMainBTM, RealClearChain, the ply_* commands, ply_endtie, TrackStop EQUIV; MPlayMain, ply_note, m4aSoundVSync in C (not yet EQUIV-tested); MPlayJumpTableCopy copies the relocated template
Oam_BuildBufferKernel, Decompress_ByteLzArm EQUIV; palette fade kernels, Decompress_HalfwordLz todo
tagged LZ (forms 0/1), move-to-front LZ (form 2), Resource_PatchThumbBranch, Resource_ExecuteTransfer: EQUIV (all ROM resources)
Message_FindArm, Text_DecodeSymbol: EQUIV on real messages
Tile_Decompress4bpp, Tile_ExpandMasked: EQUIV
Tile_ExpandOpaque: EQUIV
Tile_ConvertMapGrid, Tile_CopyStrided EQUIV
flash driver replaced at its API (port/fn_overrides.tsv): the emulated chip is an SST 39VF512
Render_DecodePicture EQUIV (its table cache in the RAM copy not kept: the tables are ROM); TileMap_DrawRows (World Map) todo
Mixer_Enter/Mixer_Run: EQUIV (whole VBlanks, GS-audio)
channel envelope, block mixer, resampler kernels, synth waves: EQUIV through Mixer_Enter
general resampling loop, block mixer, normalize: EQUIV through Mixer_Enter
SoundMainRAM (library mixer) not ported: unused, the game mixes through Mixer_Enter
